messages:
erin: Pager -> gen-api US-West: elevated 5xx and TTFB spikes. Triage started. I think it's genqueue/backpressure causing kv-cache hotness. Drafting a quick status page blurb, need quick review & legal ok. @sre_josh @product_liz

oncall-bot: Pager triggered: P1 generation errors in US-West (service: gen-api). Incident created: INC-2026-032. Link: https://pager.example/INC-2026-032

sre_josh: Looking. Can you post a short impact summary for customers? e.g., services affected, percent of requests, ETA to next update.

erin: Impact: text-generation endpoints in US-West; ~7-9% requests failed with 500/504 since 10:14 PDT; some customers see increased latencies. No billing impact. Mitigation: scaled genqueue workers + rolled tokenization node config. Next update in 15m. Draft candidate 1: 'We are investigating elevated errors and latency for text-generation in US-West. Our engineers are working on mitigation; some requests may fail or be delayed. We will provide updates every 15 minutes.'

product_liz: Candidate OK but add 'no data loss' and mention remediation steps? Candidate 2: 'We are investigating elevated errors and increased latency for text-generation in US-West. Some requests may see failures or delays. We are scaling capacity and applying configuration fixes. No customer data was impacted. Next update: in 15 minutes.'

erin: I'll combine. Draft for statuspage initial post:

```We are currently investigating elevated errors and increased latency for text-generation requests in the US-West region. Some requests may fail or be delayed. Our on-call engineers are scaling capacity and applying a configuration fix to tokenizers/genqueue. No customer data has been accessed or lost. We will post updates every 15 minutes.```

legal_sam: quick FYI, wording 'no customer data has been accessed' is fine. Avoid promising ETA. Replace 'applying' with 'deploying'.

erin: Updated draft:

```We are currently investigating elevated errors and increased latency for text-generation requests in the US-West region. Some requests may fail or be delayed. Our engineers are scaling capacity and deploying a configuration fix to tokenizers/genqueue. No customer data has been accessed or lost. We will post updates every 15 minutes.```

sre_josh: +1. Can we add a short internal note for statuspage metadata: affected: gen-api (text-gen), severity: partial degradation, region: US-West, undetermined root cause, mitigation: scale + config rollback if needed.

erin: added metadata and queued publish. @pagebot publish-staging INC-2026-032 -> statuspage.draft

pagebot: Statuspage draft created: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026-032/draft (preview link).

product_liz: looks good. Suggest we include contact line for enterprise customers: 'Enterprise customers impacted will be notified directly by support.'

erin: Added. Publishing now to Public (initial):
`/page publish INC-2026-032 initial`

pagebot: Public update posted (initial). Link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026-032
Reaction: :loudspeaker:

erin: Follow-up: after scaling we see error rate down to ~2% and latency improving. Draft update for 10:30:

```Update 10:30 PDT: Error rates have decreased and latency is improving. We continue monitoring; some customers may still see degraded performance. Engineers continue to validate the configuration fix.```

sre_josh: Good. Remove 'some customers may still see' -> sounds vague. Maybe 'a small percentage of requests may still be affected.'

erin: Updated and queued:
`/page publish INC-2026-032 update`

pagebot: Public update posted (10:30 PDT). Link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026-032#update-1030

product_liz: Ping support to inform enterprise list.

erin: @support-team FYI: enterprise customers potentially affected; see incident link.

support-team: Acknowledged, will notify priority accounts.

legal_sam: Approve final resolved language once we confirm 0.5% error rate for 15m.

erin: After monitoring, error rate steady at 0.4% for last 20m, kv-cache hot shards drained. Marking resolved. Resolved draft:

```Resolved 11:05 PDT: The issues causing elevated errors and latency for text-generation in US-West have been mitigated. Error rates have returned to baseline and traffic is normal. No customer data was impacted. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support.```

sre_josh: +1 to publish resolved.

erin: `/page publish INC-2026-032 resolved`

pagebot: Incident INC-2026-032 marked as Resolved and final update published. Link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026-032#resolved
Reaction: :white_check_mark:

product_liz: Thanks team. Post-mortem next steps: collect logs, confirm root cause (genqueue backpressure + tokenizer memory config), plan follow-up PR.
